quote: We experiment with two top-performing GQA models, MAC and LXMERT to test their generalization on our automatic contrast sets.

We sampled 553 images, each one with an original and perturbed QA pair for a total of 1,106 instances... The (image, question) pairs were answered independently by human annotators on Amazon Mechanical Turk... We found that the workers were able to correctly answer 72.3% of the perturbed questions, slightly lower than their performance on the original questions (76.6%).
